All three are monotone and inside |p-2.0| <= 0.3.

protocol_findings_C1_C2_C3.statement: C1 closed: section 4.1 R1-R4 make each scheme's own structural functional the pass/fail object and demote the leapfrog functional to a labelled cross-check (measured ratios 5.95e6 cnfd, 4.15e5 cnfem). C2 closed: section 3.2, 3.8 and section 6 amendment (e) require >= 4 rungs for an order-certification claim; the 4-rung addendum already exists and is recomputed above. C3 closed: R5/R5a require p +/- delta with least-squares SE and pair half-range, a named norm, and |p_A-p_B| <= max(0.25, sqrt(delta_A^2+delta_B^2)); the 3-rung historical artifact stays delta-free and is labelled supporting only.

negative_controls.statement: Controls are measured and fail as required; protocol section 5 matches the measured control set.
